fixed_paragraph: When I walk into a room full of people, I immediately start chatting with everyone. When I hear music playing, I can't help but start dancing. When I'm at a party, I make sure to mingle and talk to as many people as possible. When I see someone sitting alone, I go over and invite them to join the group. When I encounter a new experience, I dive in headfirst with excitement.
